evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies option validation in sendall under src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.
rationale: Strict option validation in sendall prevents unintentional spending of all UTXOs or unexpected broadcasting caused by misspelled keys like inputs or add_to_wallet. As the PR notes, silently ignoring unrecognized options can cause a caller who typos input to spend all wallet UTXOs instead of the targeted subset, creating a tangible fund-safety and operational hazard.
